fields.label: Encounter
fields.description: 1:1 with Encounter -- holds the uhis_lf_mobile wire-only fields that have no FHIR analog, so Encounter itself stays clean for its other consumer (flutter-uhis-next).

fields.label: Service Provided
fields.description: Verbatim wire assessmentType (e.g. "NCD", "ANC") -- Encounter.encounter_type only models Routine/Followup/Emergency/Referral, not programme, and member_assessment_history's serviceProvided is read back from here.

fields.label: Village
fields.description: Resolved server-side from the wire's numeric villageId -- see the Geography Node legacy-village-id mapping.

fields.label: Visit Number
fields.description: ANC/PNC visit number (1-based). Null for non-ANC/PNC encounters.

fields.label: Custom Status
fields.description: Verbatim copy of the wire's encounter.customStatus string list.

fields.label: Referred Reasons
fields.description: Comma-joined string, verbatim from the wire -- not an array, matching the client's own LocalAssessmentEntity.toApiRequest shape.
